data.body:
VERIFICATION EVIDENCE (Gerrit change 1416)

Premise correction: the ticket assumed no bootstrap path installs lizard. Refuted and
re-plated. pyproject's [dev] extra self-references nava-rebar[agents,metrics], and
metrics = [lizard>=1.23], so 'uv sync --locked --extra dev' already pulls lizard
transitively. PROOF: a worktree provisioned by 'make worktree' on UNMODIFIED main
imported lizard 1.23.0. AC 'a fresh venv can import lizard' already passed on main.
The Makefile change is therefore hardening (pins the dev-env intent independently of
the CI-motivated self-reference), not a fix. Plan-review BLOCKED on exactly this
(E4/G6); plan rewritten, re-review PASS, certified at 31f352d5.

Evidence per AC, all with scc and jscpd made unresolvable via a sanitized PATH
(608 symlinks from /opt/homebrew/bin minus those two; uv/node/etc still present):

- uv lock --check -> exit 0, 'Resolved 177 packages'; uv.lock absent from git status
  (zero lock churn -- the metrics extra was already locked).
- make install -> exit 0 ('Checked 100 packages', no new installs = behaviour-preserving).
- make lint -> exit 0. make typecheck -> exit 0 (433 source files).
- Full suite (make test) -> 10234 passed, 38 skipped, 222 deselected, exit 0, 32m20s.
- rebar metrics -> exit 0 with structured unavailable: module_size_distribution
  'scc executable is unavailable', duplication_summary 'jscpd executable not found',
  while complexity_summary still returned real lizard values. No hard failure.
- A from-scratch uv sync into an empty dir yielded lizard 1.23.0.
- CI-only gates also green: comment-hygiene, config-check, server-manifest,
  verify-gate-parity, raw-git-write, docs-index.

make worktree: confirmed by inspection to delegate to   [36mhelp        [0m Show the available targets.
  [36minstall     [0m Install rebar from the committed uv.lock (uv sync --locked, dev + metrics extras) + the pre-commit hook (the commit gate).
  [36minstall-unlocked[0m Fallback: editable pip install (UNLOCKED — resolves fresh; prefer `make install`).
  [36mhooks       [0m (Re)install the pre-commit git hook and VERIFY it landed (the commit gate).
  [36mworktree    [0m Create a fresh worktree from origin/main + provision its venv & hooks. Usage: make worktree name=<branch> [dir=<path>]
  [36mformat      [0m MUTATES: auto-fix lint + format the code (the ONLY rewriting target).
  [36mlint        [0m ERRORS ONLY (never mutates): ruff lint + format-check + zizmor (release.yml) + actionlint (all workflows) + DCO identity consistency. The gate CI runs.
  [36mactionlint-bin[0m Ensure a pinned actionlint is available (repo-local, digest-verified install if absent).
  [36mverify-mcp-pin[0m Verify the embedded mcp-publisher SHA-256 matches the live pinned download.
  [36mtypecheck   [0m ERRORS ONLY: mypy over the whole library (gating; full src/rebar).
  [36mconfig-check[0m ERRORS ONLY: validate every infra config (fails CI on a malformed config -> can't reach main).
  [36mcheck       [0m Run every check-only gate (no mutation).
  [36mtest        [0m Run the default test suite (excludes integration + external).
  [36mjira-dc-up  [0m Build + start the Jira DC verification harness (fresh instance; see tests/external/live_jira_dc/README.md).
  [36mjira-dc-down[0m Stop + remove the Jira DC verification harness.
  [36mchangelog   [0m Prepend the unreleased CHANGELOG.md section for a release: make changelog VERSION=vX.Y.Z (generate-then-curate; never a full regen).
  [36mvendor-security-rules[0m Print how to refresh the vendored security rule subset (WS5). install, so worktree
venvs are covered with no second edit.

CI unaffected: no workflow invokes 'make install'; every one calls 'uv sync --locked
--extra ...' or 'pip install -e .' directly. No workflow change needed.

Structural corroboration for the degrade-not-fail claim: scc/jscpd are referenced only
under src/rebar/metrics/analyzers/, never in a build/lint/typecheck path. scc_loc.py
builds ['scc', '--format', 'json', scan_root] -- the missing --by-file of bug
c5b3-1b8a-08dd-40af, documented as a known gap rather than configured around.

Out of scope as planned: no [code_health] section in rebar.toml.
